visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a brown blazer and black dress is seen hugging a man wearing a grey backpack in a brightly lit indoor hallway. She smiles broadly while the man rests his head on her shoulder. (2) The camera shifts to a close-up of the man's face; he wears glasses and is visibly emotional, laughing through tears while holding a pink paper shopping bag. (3) Intercut scenes show a stage performance with a colorful set depicting a domestic interior; actors in various costumes are performing and eventually taking bows under stage lights. (4) The woman films the emotional man with her smartphone as they stand near a table with refreshments; the background features white walls and a storage room door labeled in Chinese. (5) A final sequence shows a group of actors on a large stage waving to an audience in a darkened theater hall during a curtain call.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female voice interacts with a crying, emotional male voice over a gentle piano background. The male voice is shaky with high spectral tension and breathiness, punctuated by short laughing bursts. (2) Music transitions into a more cinematic string-heavy track as the male voice begins a narrative overview about the musical show. (3) Loud crowd applause and cheering transients emerge during clips of a stage performance, momentarily increasing the ambient noise floor. (4) The primary narrator returns with a steady, professional tone to provide ticket information, while the sentimental piano music continues at a lower volume to the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Emotional Interaction -> Contextual Flashback -> Performance Summary -> Call-to-Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document a heartfelt emotional reaction to a musical theater performance and use that authenticity to promote the show's remaining ticket sales. It bridges the gap between the audience's emotional journey and the professional production.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct recommendation of the musical and mention of ticket availability for upcoming shows in Kaohsiung.
